head: 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e
notes: Context: ACTION-REVIEW-QUALITY-001..008 (injected) plus context/rules/go.md. Known ledger (round-1/known.json) consulted; its internal/server rows were not re-reported. Templates and style.css are walked against every group; Go-only groups answer empty for them.

findings.fix: Drop the dead `len(lines) == 0 ||` term: `if strings.TrimSpace(lines[0]) != "---" { return content }`.
findings.claim: stripFrontMatter guards `len(lines) == 0 || ...` after `lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")`; strings.Split with a non-empty separator always returns at least one element ("" -> [""]), so the len check is dead code that never fires for any input.
findings.evidence: Re-read presentation.go:184-195 at the pinned head: lines is always the result of strings.Split(content, "\n"); per the stdlib contract Split returns a one-element slice when sep is absent, including for an empty string, so len(lines)==0 is unreachable; the only real guard is the TrimSpace(lines[0]) comparison. Not in the known ledger (known NIT-11/NIT-19/NIT-22/NIT-198 cover other parts of this file).

findings.fix: Title: translate(s.presentation.language(), "Sessions") + " — " + translate(s.presentation.language(), "archive") — the same shape handleSessionsScope uses.
findings.claim: The new handleSessionsArchiveTab hard-codes Title "Sessions — archive", while its sibling handleSessionsScope (changed in the same diff) builds the title as translate(language, "Sessions") + " — " + scope and germanCatalog already carries both "Sessions" and "archive"; on a German profile the archive tab's <title> stays English while every other sessions tab reads "Sitzungen — …".
findings.evidence: Re-read sessions.go:127-140 (archive tab, literal title) against sessions.go:154-175 (scope tab, translated title) and i18n.go:10 and :24 ("Sessions" -> "Sitzungen", "archive" -> "Archiv"); layout.html:7 renders .Title into <title>. Input: presentation profile language: de, GET /sessions/archive -> <title>Sessions — archive</title>. Not in the known ledger (known NIT-5 is the duplicated scope-name loop, MAJ-2 the route shadowing).
